sourceContext: Costa Clean App ChatGPT Project - canonical baseline recertification after invalidating CC-CMD-0001
objective: Recertify the accepted Costa Clean canonical baseline 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce using a new isolated run and publish factual verification evidence without repairing application code.
why: CC-CMD-0001 and its run were invalidated because the run was bound to 64386f167391578148616ce4242d18bc1523d18e instead of the accepted canonical baseline. A clean recertification must start from the exact accepted baseline with immutable binding.
scope: Bind the new run immutably to accepted canonical baseline 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce.
Create a fresh isolated execution worktree from exactly 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce.
Inspect the repository and accepted Brain read-only.
Provision local dependencies deterministically from the repository lockfile in the isolated worktree.
Run the repository's configured tests, lint, typecheck when available, and build commands.
Record PASS, FAIL, NOT_CONFIGURED, NOT_RUN, or UNKNOWN only from structured evidence.
Produce a FactMatrix and ExecutionReport bound to this command, its new run, the accepted Brain, and the exact baseline.
Publish the factual CommandExecutionResult only to orchestrator/control.
Leave the human Costa Clean checkout untouched.
outOfScope: Reusing or repairing the invalid historical execution worktree.
Functional application code changes or test repairs.
Changing migration files, release manifests, expected hashes, or application behavior to make verification pass.
GitHub main changes, pull requests, merges, releases, or tags.
Secrets, billing, DNS, external email, payments, or destructive operations.
Selecting or implementing a new product feature after certification.
acceptanceCriteria: A new run is created for CC-CMD-0002 and the invalid CC-CMD-0001 run is not reused.
The new run's immutable baseline equals 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce before any verification command executes.
The isolated execution worktree HEAD equals 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce.
Tests, lint, typecheck when available, and build are executed or explicitly reported with a truthful non-PASS state and reason.
Every verification value is preserved consistently from FactMatrix through ExecutionReport to CommandExecutionResult.
No functional application source file is modified.
The human Costa Clean checkout remains untouched.
The final factual result is published to orchestrator/control with idempotent reconciliation.
Application verification failures are reported but not repaired by this command.
stopConditions: Project identity, Brain hash, command hash, accepted baseline, or worktree binding mismatch.
The runtime attempts to reuse CC-CMD-0001 or its invalid run.
The execution worktree HEAD is not exactly 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce.
Any unexpected mutation occurs in the human Costa Clean checkout.
Any required remote or production action outside the authorized control-plane result write.
Ambiguous side-effect state or unreconciled execution state.
Any attempt is made to modify functional application code or repair target failures.
verificationRequirements: Verify project identity and accepted Brain binding before creating the run.
Verify the immutable run baseline equals 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce before worktree execution.
Verify the isolated worktree HEAD and status before and after verification.
Verify the new run ID differs from ar_3c5298ae-eee5-40d5-b7f2-0f29f641c7be.
Capture exact commands, working directory, exit codes, and evidence for tests, lint, typecheck, and build.
Bind all FactMatrix and ExecutionReport evidence to projectId, commandId, runId, Brain version/hash, and baseline.
Verify functional source diff is empty.
Verify the human checkout is unchanged.
Verify no Supabase, Vercel, production, or unauthorized GitHub mutations occurred.
Verify no evidence from CC-CMD-0001 or its invalid run contaminates the new result.
